pages.text: The tool you point at everything in this mod. It has four modes, and $(o)sneak$() and right-click in the air steps between them. The tool takes the colour of the mode it is set to, so you can see which one you are on.

pages.title: Configure
pages.text: The default mode, and the one you will spend the most time in.$(br2)On a $(o)cable face$(): flips it between insert and extract. Only faces touching a machine have a mode at all.$(br)On an $(o)energy cell$(): steps that face through disabled, input, output and both.$(br2)It also pulls a facade back off a covered face.

pages.title: Clear, Rotate, Wrench
pages.text: $(o)Clear$() puts a face straight back to its resting state, which beats cycling round to it.$(br2)$(o)Rotate$() turns a block a quarter turn around the face you clicked, for the pieces whose facing matters.$(br2)$(o)Wrench$() takes the block back into your hand with everything it was carrying: a cable keeps its upgrades and facades, a cell keeps its charge. Sneaking and right-clicking does this in any mode.
